_about: Click-through demos for the Core repair order agent (Repair order mode). starters: one-click openers on a new repair order, short owner fragments (year, model, mileage, symptom, no full sentences): rewriting them into a proper customer concern is one of the agent's jobs. scenarios: the Demo menu; the first step is the owner's fragment, the steps after it are the advisor's own shorthand, so the model has to decode it. Steps that do not start with a correctly spelled 'add' go to the model; 'total?' is answered by the deterministic rules. laborRate is used for the session only when the shop has not set one.

scenarios.title: CV axle: typos to a priced job, both sides cheaper
scenarios.intro: Demo: an owner's fragment with a VIN, then the advisor's shorthand with typos. Watch the agent rewrite the concern, match the OEM schedule from the VIN, offer add-on labor with a customer line, and price both sides as one job.

scenarios.title: A/C: two parts replaced, one recharge billed
scenarios.intro: Demo: a compressor and a condenser on the same car. Each needs the A/C evacuated and recharged, but the system is only recharged once, so only one is billed.

scenarios.title: Water pump: the thermostat for a fraction of the labor
scenarios.intro: Demo: the advisor throws in a thermostat with a water pump. The labor guide prices it as add-on labor, not a second job, and the agent explains it to the customer.

scenarios.title: Valve cover: spark plugs for 0.3 h because the intake is already off
scenarios.intro: Demo: a rear valve cover leak on a V6 means the intake comes off. Spark plugs added now are add-on labor instead of a separate job.
